name: Super Muscle Knight
detailed_description:
"Super Muscle Knight" is a ‘climbing’ game in which players aim for the top while striking macho poses.

Wearing a mysterious mask that generates magnetic force when you strike a macho pose, and aim for the top without giving up no matter how many times you fall.

No matter how high you fall, you will not die, so you can try again and again until your heart breaks.

Game Features

  • 2D platform game with colorful pixel art.

  • The world has various obstacles such as falling scaffolds, sliding scaffolds, and burning scaffolds, and we must find a way to overcome them.

  • Pursue a simple but profound play with walking, jumping, and Muscle Pose.

  • When a wall cannot be overcome by jumping or an obstacle is in the way, use Muscle Pose to generate magnetic force to overcome it. Calm down and look around you.

  • Please remember that one mistake can cost you everything you have built up......
